notes: Golden set for `npm run rank:eval`. Each fixture has a human `label` (post | maybe | skip) and an `item` (RankInputItem WITHOUT publishedAt). `ageHours` (default 2) is turned into a fresh publishedAt at eval time so recency is reproducible and items don't age out of the hard filter. Run `npm run rank:seed` to append ~30 real recent headlines (unlabeled), then fill in each `label`. The rows below are a labeled starter so the eval runs out of the box.

item.title: Anthropic launches Claude for Enterprise with 500K-token context
item.summary: Anthropic released Claude for Enterprise, adding a 500K-token context window, SSO, and audit logs. Available today; priced per seat with usage-based tiers.

item.title: Chennai deeptech startup raises $20M Series A to build indigenous AI chips
item.summary: A Chennai-based semiconductor startup raised a $20M Series A led by Peak XV to tape out its first AI inference chip, aiming at edge devices in India.

item.title: Figma adds an AI layout assistant to its design tool
item.summary: Figma introduced an AI assistant that suggests layouts and auto-arranges frames, rolling out to Professional and Organization plans over the coming weeks.

item.title: Indian SaaS startup crosses $10M ARR two years after launch
item.summary: A Bengaluru SaaS company said it crossed $10M in annual recurring revenue, two years after launch, driven by US mid-market customers.

item.title: Why artificial intelligence is the most important technology of our time
item.summary: An essay arguing that AI will reshape every industry and why leaders must pay attention now, with broad predictions about the coming decade.

item.title: You won't BELIEVE what this AI startup just did to Big Tech
item.summary: Experts are stunned by a tiny startup's move. Here's everything you need to know about the company that could change the industry forever.

item.title: Report: OpenAI may be considering a new hardware device, sources say
item.summary: People familiar with the matter say OpenAI has discussed building a consumer hardware device. Plans are early and could change; OpenAI declined to comment.

item.title: Google DeepMind open-sources a protein-folding model for researchers
item.summary: Google DeepMind released weights for a smaller protein-structure prediction model under a research license, letting labs run it locally.
